findings.message: The page at 0x661 is cut short after 699 bytes of 701 bytes; decoders drop it with its packets.

The logical stream 0x0B0B0030 has no end-of-stream page: its last page at 0x661 sets the flag but is damaged, so decoders drop it, and it ends before the end of the data, so the file was probably cut short or not finished.
